note.headline: Treasury yields hit fresh highs before an auction eased the selloff, while expectations of higher long-end yields persisted.
takeaways: The 10-year Treasury yield peaked at 5.364% before a strong auction eased the selloff.
Fed minutes pointed to another increase this year, even as Polymarket put the odds of no change in October at 83.5%.
Oil rose on supply threats, while French fiscal concerns weighed on the euro.

items.title: Auction checks Treasury selloff
items.body: The 10-year yield reached 5.364% before a strong auction eased the selloff. Polymarket odds of the 30-year yield reaching a higher threshold rose 14.8pp in a day to 68.7%.

items.title: Year-end Fed outlook differs from October pricing
items.body: Fed minutes showed most officials expected another rate increase this year. Polymarket odds of no change at the October meeting stood at 83.5%, up 18.0pp over a week.

items.title: Supply threats lift oil
items.body: Brent and WTI each rose 0.92% as Gulf storm risk and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia threatened supply.

items.title: French fiscal concerns pressure euro
items.body: The euro fell 0.83% against the dollar as French fiscal worries returned to focus.
